parts.t: Work out the number of people who drank tea only.
Work out the number of people who drank none of these three drinks.

Find the probability that this person drank exactly two of the three drinks.

sols: Start from the centre: 8 drank all three.
always fill a Venn diagram inwards‑out
the 15 includes the 8 in the centre
Coffee and juice only = 12 − 8 = 4, coffee only = 28 − (7 + 4 + 8) = 9, juice only = 20 − (2 + 4 + 8) = 6.
Total who drank at least one = 13 + 9 + 6 + 7 + 4 + 2 + 8 = 49.
Exactly two drinks means the three regions where just two circles overlap.
these do not include the 8 in the centre
